item.title: Chameleon: Unobtrusive Substitution of Real-World Obstacles in VR
item.description: Chameleon is a risk-level–aware system that unobtrusively substitutes real-world obstacles inside VR, preserving immersion while improving safety and accessibility. Accepted to CHI EA 2025.
